# Go Modules

Go Modules adalah sistem manajemen dependency resmi di Go (diperkenalkan pada Go 1.11, resmi pada Go 1.16). Modules menggantikan `GOPATH` sebagai cara mengelola proyek dan dependencies.

## Membuat Module Baru

```bash
mkdir myproject
cd myproject
go mod init github.com/username/myproject
```

Perintah ini membuat file `go.mod` di direktori proyek.

## Struktur `go.mod`

```
module github.com/username/myproject

go 1.22

require (
    github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
    github.com/stretchr/testify v1.8.4
)
```

Komponen dalam `go.mod`:
- **module** — path unik modul Anda (biasanya URL repository)
- **go** — versi minimum Go yang dibutuhkan
- **require** — daftar dependency dan versinya

## File `go.sum`

File `go.sum` berisi **checksum kriptografis** dari setiap dependency:

```
github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1 h1:4idEAncQnU5cB7BeOkPtxjfCSye0AAm1R0RVIqJ+Jmg=
github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1/go.mod h1:hPrL7YrpYKXt5YId3A/Tnip5kqbEAP+KLuI3SUcPTeU=
```

File ini **tidak boleh diedit manual** dan harus di-commit ke version control untuk menjamin keamanan dependency.

## Perintah go mod

### `go get` — Tambahkan atau update dependency
```bash
# Tambahkan dependency baru
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Tambahkan versi spesifik
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.9.1

# Update ke versi terbaru
go get -u github.com/gin-gonic/gin
```

### `go mod tidy` — Bersihkan dependency
```bash
go mod tidy
```
Menambahkan dependency yang hilang dan menghapus dependency yang tidak digunakan.

### `go mod vendor` — Salin dependency ke folder vendor
```bash
go mod vendor
```
Menyalin semua dependency ke folder `vendor/` untuk build offline.

### `go mod verify` — Verifikasi integritas dependency
```bash
go mod verify
```
Memastikan dependency yang terunduh sesuai dengan checksum di `go.sum`.

## Contoh: Menggunakan External Package

Misalkan kita ingin menggunakan package `color` dari `fatih`:

```bash
go get github.com/fatih/color
```

Kemudian gunakan di kode:

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/fatih/color"
)

func main() {
    color.Cyan("Hello dari package eksternal!")
    fmt.Println("Module bekerja dengan baik")
}
```

## Ringkasan Perintah Modules

| Perintah | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `go mod init <path>` | Inisialisasi module baru |
| `go get <package>` | Tambahkan dependency |
| `go mod tidy` | Sinkronkan go.mod dengan kode |
| `go mod vendor` | Salin ke folder vendor |
| `go mod verify` | Verifikasi checksum dependency |
| `go mod download` | Download dependency ke cache |

# Go Modules

Go Modules is the official dependency management system in Go (introduced in Go 1.11, official in Go 1.16). Modules replaced `GOPATH` as the way to manage projects and dependencies.

## Creating a New Module

```bash
mkdir myproject
cd myproject
go mod init github.com/username/myproject
```

This creates a `go.mod` file in the project directory.

## Structure of `go.mod`

```
module github.com/username/myproject

go 1.22

require (
    github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
    github.com/stretchr/testify v1.8.4
)
```

Components in `go.mod`:
- **module** — unique path for your module (usually a repository URL)
- **go** — the minimum required Go version
- **require** — list of dependencies and their versions

## The `go.sum` File

The `go.sum` file contains **cryptographic checksums** of each dependency:

```
github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1 h1:4idEAncQnU5cB7BeOkPtxjfCSye0AAm1R0RVIqJ+Jmg=
github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1/go.mod h1:hPrL7YrpYKXt5YId3A/Tnip5kqbEAP+KLuI3SUcPTeU=
```

This file **must not be edited manually** and should be committed to version control to guarantee dependency security.

## go mod Commands

### `go get` — Add or update a dependency
```bash
# Add a new dependency
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Add a specific version
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.9.1

# Update to latest version
go get -u github.com/gin-gonic/gin
```

### `go mod tidy` — Clean up dependencies
```bash
go mod tidy
```
Adds missing dependencies and removes unused ones.

### `go mod vendor` — Copy dependencies to vendor folder
```bash
go mod vendor
```
Copies all dependencies into a `vendor/` directory for offline builds.

### `go mod verify` — Verify dependency integrity
```bash
go mod verify
```
Ensures downloaded dependencies match the checksums in `go.sum`.

## Example: Using an External Package

To use the `color` package from `fatih`:

```bash
go get github.com/fatih/color
```

Then use it in code:

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/fatih/color"
)

func main() {
    color.Cyan("Hello from an external package!")
    fmt.Println("Module is working correctly")
}
```

## Module Commands Summary

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `go mod init <path>` | Initialize a new module |
| `go get <package>` | Add a dependency |
| `go mod tidy` | Sync go.mod with code |
| `go mod vendor` | Copy to vendor folder |
| `go mod verify` | Verify dependency checksums |
| `go mod download` | Download dependencies to cache |
